content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@8e8c483db84b4bee98b60c0593521ed34d9990e8 # v6.0.1
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@395ad3262231945c25e8478fd5baf05154b1d79f # v6.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      - name: 🧪 Run Tests
        run: npm test
